workflow:
name: Publish web viewer

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - "feat/**"
    paths:
      - "web/**"
      - "scripts/audit_web.py"
      - ".github/workflows/pages.yml"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

concurrency:
  group: pages
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  verificar:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      - name: Set up Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install pyproj rasterio numpy
          npm install playwright
          npx playwright install chromium
      - name: Run verificar.py
        run: python scripts/verificar.py --criticos

  deploy:
    needs: verificar
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Validate static site and asset manifest
        shell: bash
        run: |
          python - <<'PY'
          import json
          from pathlib import Path

          root = Path("web").resolve()
          manifest_path = root / "manifest.json"
          manifest = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
          referenced = [*manifest.get("pmtiles", []), *manifest.get("geojson", []), *manifest.get("media", [])]

          for item in referenced:
              path = (root / item).resolve()
              if root not in path.parents:
                  raise SystemExit(f"Manifest path escapes web/: {item}")
              if not path.is_file():
                  raise SystemExit(f"Manifest asset is missing: {item}")
              if path.stat().st_size >= 95 * 1024 * 1024:
                  raise SystemExit(f"Web asset exceeds 95 MB: {item}")
              if item.lower().endswith(".mp4") and path.stat().st_size >= 50 * 1024 * 1024:
                  raise SystemExit(f"MP4 exceeds 50 MB: {item}")
              if item.lower().endswith(".glb") and path.stat().st_size >= 20 * 1024 * 1024:
                  raise SystemExit(f"GLB exceeds 20 MB: {item}")

          for path in root.rglob("*"):
              if not path.is_file():
                  continue
              relative = path.relative_to(root).as_posix()
              if path.stat().st_size >= 95 * 1024 * 1024:
                  raise SystemExit(f"Web file exceeds 95 MB: {relative}")
              if relative.endswith((".part", ".copying", ".tmp", ".temp.db", ".mbtiles", "-journal", "-wal", "-shm")):
                  raise SystemExit(f"Temporary processing file in web/: {relative}")

          print(f"Validated {len(referenced)} manifest assets and site file size limits.")
